title: A step toward: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input and rejecting every quadrangle input has at least 64 gates (step 2 of 2)
statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 : List ℕ),   x2.length ≤ (2 : ℕ) →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →       (∀ (x5 : Fin x1.gates.length), ∀ x6 ∈ (x1.gates.get x5).inputs, x6 < (27 : ℕ) + ↑x5) →         have x6 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))};         have x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → List Bool := fun (x7 x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (List.ofFn fun (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x9 = x7)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x9 = x8);         have x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x9 ∈ x8)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x10 ∈ x8, x10 - x9 ∉ x6);         have x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x9 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x9.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x11 ∈ x9 | x11 - x10 ∈ x6}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ);         have x10 : List Bool → List Bool := fun (x10 : List Bool) => x10 ++ [x2.any fun (x11 : ℕ) => x10.getD x11 Bool.false];         (∀ (x11 x12 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x11 - x12 ∈ x6 → x1.eval (x10 (x7 x11 x12)) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x12 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x9 x12 → x1.eval (x10 (x8 x12)) = Bool.false) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
unlocks: With its 1 sibling(s) it proves a posted step.
context: A hypothesis of a checked reduction, as Lean printed it.
sketch: Step 2 of 2 of a checked cut of L-meta-1692. Its sibling steps: L-meta-2341. Together they give the parent; the parent's own sketch: no proof is held; open for REDUCTIONS.
